findings.ac: AC2 No references to deleted scripts in README, docs, or other scripts
findings.text: test_no_live_references_to_legacy_installers scans only LIVE_ROOTS (README.md, src, scripts, build, tests, .github, dist/skills) and omits docs/, though the AC names docs; docs/plans/stratos-4-1-followups-plan.md:49 still tells the reader to run `install-antigravity.ps1 --global` and `install-claude-code.sh --global` (forward-looking step, not purely historical), and docs/design/BT-108-interface.md and the PRD still name the scripts.

findings.ac: AC3 tests/install-harness passes 100% / Path: validate npx skills add and marketplace paths
findings.text: No test in the diff runs or asserts the harness passes (only CI job install-harness-l1 running run-L1.sh, which is unchanged); run-L1.sh/.ps1 validate only the plain-copy Track B, and nothing in tests/install-harness exercises `npx skills add` (marketplace is a manual post-merge --marketplace cell), so the Path item 'validate npx skills add and marketplace paths' is not proven.

The edited stratosphere-update SKILL.md still gates the Antigravity update on `<plugin>/.install-source.json` and the plugin dir, while install-antigravity-bridge.sh copies to a skills dir and does not write .install-source.json, so a bridge install always hits the 'one-time manual step ... Future updates will be automatic' HALT; test_update_preflight.py only asserts the substring 'install-antigravity-bridge', not that the flow works with the bridge.
